summary: Aris Mining Corporation filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated November 12, 2026, announcing positive Prefeasibility Study results for its Toroparu Gold Project in Guyana. The PFS cites 5.9 Moz proven and probable reserves, 5.6 Moz planned production over 29 years, an after-tax NPV(5%) of $2.8 billion and 31.5% IRR at $3,600/oz gold, with an initial funding requirement of $1,005 million. Construction decision is targeted for early 2027 subject to approvals; no transaction, stake, or price is involved. No board recommendation or advisor is named.
